markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?

The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: JD Vance holds the leading trader consensus at 23.6% as vice president with consistent early leads in Republican primary polling averages around 40%, reflecting institutional advantages and alignment with the current administration. Democratic contenders remain more fragmented, with Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Jon Ossoff, Gavin Newsom, and Kamala Harris drawing support amid varying state and national snapshots that show no dominant frontrunner. Key differentiators include Republican access to Trump-era networks versus Democratic emphasis on primary turnout among progressive and moderate blocs. Consolidation behind one outcome could hinge on 2027-2028 primary results, Senate dynamics, or major policy developments that shift voter coalitions in battleground states.
